title: How local businesses win customers with simple content
caption: You don't need viral. You need the RIGHT 500 locals to know you exist. Run P.O.S.T. on your next piece of content.

video.hookLine: of people who search for a local service on their phone visit a business within a day.
video.credibility: This is the exact content plan we run for our own web design studio.

steps.title: Pick
steps.point: Choose one problem your customer actually googles.

steps.title: Offer
steps.point: Give one useful answer. No fluff, no hard sell.

steps.title: Show
steps.point: Prove it with a real example from your own work.

steps.title: Tag
steps.point: Name your city and your niche so the right people find it.

video.example: A plumber we know books most jobs from five simple how-to videos.
video.ctaQuestion: What does your ideal customer search for?
video.ctaOffer: Follow for one local marketing play every week.
